title: Lien-Release Charge on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Loan Payoff Benefits by State
content:
**State schedule.** Where a payoff shortfall exists on a vehicle surrendered as a total loss under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, the loss payee's charge for releasing its lien on a paid-off total loss is added to the loan payoff benefit, outside the benefit cap: 15 on a policy whose policy state is OH or IN, 10 on a policy whose policy state is KY or WV, and nothing in any other state. Where there is no shortfall, no benefit and no charge is paid.

The policy state is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record.

| Policy state | Lien-release charge added (USD) |
|---|---|
| OH | 15 |
| IN | 15 |
| KY | 10 |
| WV | 10 |
| VA (any other state) | 0 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- OH policy, payoff shortfall 4800.00, benefit cap 4500.00: the capped figure is 4500.00 and the charge of 15 is added outside the cap, 4515.00 in all.
- KY policy, payoff shortfall 1200.00, benefit cap 4500.00: 1200.00 plus 10 gives 1210.00.
- VA policy, payoff shortfall 1200.00: 1200.00, no charge added.
- WV policy, payoff shortfall 0.00: no benefit and no charge.
